senses.gloss:
Doha, ‘milking,’ is a common word in the Atharvaveda and later. Reference is made in the Sūtras to the sāyaṃ-doha, ‘evening milking,’ and the prātar-doha, ‘morning milking.’ Dohana has the same sense. See also Go.
Foot notes iv. 11, 4. 9. 12; v. 17, 17; viii. 9, 15 (where five milkings are referred to metaphorically). In Rv. x. 42, 2, the literal sense is found.
Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, viii. 62; taittirīya brāhmaṇa, i. 1, 10, 2; ii. 2, 9, 9, etc.
Kātyāyana śrauta sūtra, iv. 2, 38, etc.
Rv. viii. 12, 32; Satapatha brāhmaṇa, ix. 2, 3, 30; Kātyāyana śrauta sūtra, iv. 2, 37, etc.
